graph.title: Squidman Escape (Space Police police hover-scooter)

edges.method: cone anti-stud on stud end of pin
cone anti-stud on stud end of pin
hinge finger between hinge fingers (rear section to body)

notes: Step numbering counts sub-assemblies in booklet order: 1-6 main steps, 7-8 left wedge sub-assembly, 9 attach, 10-11 right wedge sub-assembly, 12 attach, 13-14 main steps 9-10, 15-20 rear sub-assembly steps 1-6, 21 hinge attach (no new pieces), 22 minifig steps.

The graph has 2 separate groups on purpose. The booklet builds two separate things: the police hover-scooter (every piece except p18, joined through the hinge p27-p32) and the Squidman minifigure on page 2, which holds the green '100' banknote tile p18 in its hand. The minifigure's own parts (head, torso, legs, cape) are not in the PIECE LIST, so p18 has no listed piece to join. It is not attached to the ship at any point, so I left it unconnected instead of inventing a join. Its position is null and rests_on is [].
I put p18 at step 22, the minifigure step, instead of renumbering every other step to make page 2 step 1.
Minifigure parts, cape and other parts shown in the booklet but not in the PIECE LIST are omitted.

Exact stud-cell positions are inferred from small isometric drawings. The hinge plate p32 is placed adjacent to the end of base plate p11 under the 1x4 bricks. The rear section is given grid coordinates continuing behind the body (x>=5) although it is attached by a hinge.
The rear section layering (p14, p27/p8, p15, brackets p4/p5, plate p12) is an interpretation; the side wedges p21/p22/p25/p26 and their grilles are sideways so have null positions.
Technic pins are assumed to have a stud end on which the green cones sit; both pins are assumed fitted at step 5.
Sticker sheet p33 is attached to several parts; its first use is at step 8.
